page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at top; page number top right; a catchword-like signature "I 2" at the foot is a gathering signature, and the word at the foot "macho" is a catchword-style continuation of the last line.

main_text.p: cerevisia in cellis coctorum fermen-tescit, omnia acidis halitibus repleri nemini latet. Quod si acria etiam in frigidiori aëre vel leviter fermente-scentia atque effervescentia aciditate quadam nares vehementer feriunt, quanto magis illud accidit in intestinis calidis, uti experimento supra re-lato tot studiosis spectatoribus re ipse probatum fuit. Si minus fidat naribus & dubitare pergat an acidus vapor à materia fermentescente atque effer-vescente separetur ex. gr. cucurbitæ vitreæ, in qua fit humorum efferve-scentia vel fermentatio applicet re-ortum aliquem tubulum, cujus orifi-cium inferius applicetur ollæ cui lac dulce insit & videbit aliquanto tem-pore post cum coquitur, coagulari lac actili argumento acidos vapores ex a materia effervescente fuisse distur-batos. Ructus & halitus acidi quos à idorofis tam serio non distinguendos docerent hippocratici medici, ex sto-macho

page.notes: Catchword "macho" is at the foot right; signature "I 2" at foot centre. Some letters in the text are blurred (e.g. "ortum" likely "ortum/rtum", "actili" likely "lactis"); the original printed forms are kept as far as legible. Short marks at the left edge and a decorative mark at lower right are not printed text.
